title: Tacos de Cerdo a la Parrilla
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring pork skewers grilled to perfection, served with a twist of traditional Mexican flavors. This recipe combines the smoky taste of grilled pork with the bold flavors of Mexican spices.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together chicken broth, lime juice, olive oil, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper.
2. Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through.
7. Transfer the skewers to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
8. Serve with tortillas, sliced onion, and any desired toppings.
